bullets: Own product strategy and execution. Define the vision, roadmap, and success metrics for major areas of Flossy's platform, taking products from concept through launch, adoption…
Work directly with customers. Develop a deep understanding of how businesses operate, where existing workflows break down, and which problems are worth solving.
Build alongside engineering. Translate complex problems into clear product requirements, prototype solutions, evaluate technical tradeoffs, and work closely with engineers to ship…
Develop AI-native experiences. Help define how people interact with AI agents, how agents coordinate with one another, and how businesses maintain visibility and control over…
Measure what matters. Use product analytics, experiments, customer feedback, and agent performance data to understand what's working and improve outcomes.
